mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 70 degrees, but with an elevated air quality index of 78, please take it easy outdoors.

City officials are busy with the November 4th Plan Commission meeting, which will cover various developments including the Ardent Glen addition and site plans for Milky Way. Additionally, remember that property tax bills will be mailed no later than December 15th.

There is plenty to do in our area, starting with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening today. Tomorrow, you can head downtown for the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.

Looking at the weekly report, the Verona Police Department responded to an incident on October 15th where a school bus driver was arrested for O W I. The investigation confirmed no injuries occurred to the students on board.
For dessert, stop by for today's flavor of the day, Caramel Chocolate Pecan. The restaurant is currently open, so head over anytime before they close their doors at 10:00 PM.
